verdict.rationale: Oyster offers payroll and a public API, but nothing in the evidence documents a payroll journal endpoint, a GL or journal export, or any ledger reconciliation feature. The API items found (engagements, bonuses, allowances, webhooks) and a generic mention of 'reports' are adjacent and do not deliver payroll journal data for reconciliation.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent pull payroll journal data via API or export and reconcile the entries into my ledger
